decision: Qualify TQP-38 for the retained bounded Windows native adaptive material and texture continuity profile.
alternatives_considered: judge material continuity only from lit screenshots
treat whole-window mesh identity as invariant while native edit-retention legitimately changes the active LOD topology
let shader channels or duplicated lab data replace authoritative native material samples
claim production texture quality, decals, arbitrary material blending, or cross-platform rendering from a bounded diagnostic fixture
evidence: two consecutive qualification passes with identical semantic and shader-contract signatures
6,352 baseline and 6,800 edited native vertices with zero payload, shared-position, normal, or tangent errors
550 authored vertices, including native materials 7 and 8, with authoritative query agreement
6,051 of 6,105 original unique positions shared after the LOD cycle, 99.12 percent coverage, with zero material-payload changes
exact presentation-origin compensation, large-coordinate texture anchoring, eight texture layers, seven mip levels, and retained lit/material/provenance captures
qualified_scope: bounded Windows debug native LOD1/LOD0 material IDs, authored provenance, and generated/authored weight payloads
shared-position material continuity across regular and transition surfaces and dynamic LOD topology replacement
native paint and construction material publication with authoritative sample agreement
normal/tangent validity, deterministic shader contract, mipmapped world-space triplanar diagnostics, and presentation-origin compensation
focused runner, retained signatures, editor observatory, and inspected graphical evidence
unqualified_scope: production art direction, arbitrary material blends, biome authoring, decals, texture streaming, virtual texturing, or release frame-time budgets
LOD2 and deeper hierarchies, arbitrary terrain fields, non-Windows renderers, other GPUs, low-power operation, or GPU terrain authority
render/collision/query/navigation agreement owned by TQP-39 and Gate E or production terrain authority
review: Qualification fails closed if native payload channels, shared-position identity, authoritative sample relations, LOD-cycle overlap, normal/tangent budgets, shader contract, origin compensation, stable signatures, provenance, capture hashes, focused runner, or preservation suites differ.
downstream_impact: TQP-38 authorizes only its bounded native material/presentation contract. It does not authorize production materials, performance, adaptive system agreement, Gate E, GPU authority, or production terrain.
